status: RESEARCH PASS 1 of an expected several. No field was guessed - every fact carries a source URL; anything unconfirmed is null with a reason in that device's missing_summary. Button-numbering (B) and geometry (E) are the weakest categories across all 7 devices - vendor control-layout diagrams are consistently published as images/PDFs that could not be read by the tools available this pass, and several vendor support/forum domains were blocked at the sandbox network level on every fetch attempt (vkb-sim.pro, support.virpil.com). Re-running B and E with direct (non-sandboxed) browser access is the highest-value next step.

button_numbering.notes: No VKB-published table assigns a fixed factory-default HID button index to each physical control. VKB's own materials refer to controls exclusively by physical label (A1, A2, A3, A4, B1, C1, D1, Main Trigger, Rapid Fire Trigger, F1/F2/F3, Sw1, En1) because the device is fully user-remappable in VKBDevCfg. Native firmware mode reports up to 128 buttons/16 axes/4 hats; VKBDevCfg can reduce this to 32 buttons/4 virtual devices for game compatibility - so a numeric index depends on firmware mode and profile, not a single fixed numbering. The vkb-sim.pro forum, most likely to hold a raw-number reference table, was unreachable (blocked at the sandboxed egress-proxy level on every fetch path tried).
